items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Mockups byte-identical in uploads/, screens/ copies carry minted FR ids, screen-map answers the mapping question, registry/FR-coverage/flows/standalone/chrome/tokens gates pass on fixture 1 and the plugin's own packages; no FR id or ADR number hand-picked.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Refused package exits 3 with a closed code; content problems exit 1 as JSON; unreadable or malformed files are JSON issues, not tracebacks; all checks precede the first write.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Hash and approval re-verified through brief_dir_intake before any read; mockup names must be plain file names; screen ids are slugified; ambiguous slugs and duplicate mockups refused; no existing file overwritten. Known limit: read-after-verify TOCTOU deferred to U3.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 16 plugin tests plus one integration test run the real tool and the real gate script as subprocesses; negative paths assert nothing was written.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Script 140 lines, helper in the design plugin's own lib (testable without the shared tools import), ADR-045 loaders by file path; no capped file grew.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (Project spec.md FR rows, package screen-map) and consumers (screen_registry parser, check-design-gates, FR-coverage verifier) round-tripped; CRLF page, nested > in an old comment and partial re-run probed.
